snippet.title: Diorama Break - Kickstarter Trailer
snippet.description:
PLAYABLE DEMO IS OUT NOW: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4519970/Diorama_Break_Demo

Support the game on Kickstarter: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/massimog/diorama-break

The only (tactics) JRPG where you can talk directly to the Hero. Fight through turn-based battles and awkward conversations alike.

Subscribe for email updates: https://blog.massimogauthier.com

Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/4gVZXqVHmA

Follow on X: https://x.com/studiomassimog
Follow on Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/studiomassimog.bsky.social

(you can also download the demo standalone on itch: https://massimog.itch.io/dioramabreak)
